name: Jane Doe
title: Lead Developer & Content Strategist
bioShort: Jane is a passionate developer focused on web performance and modern JavaScript frameworks. She leads the technical development of this starter template.
bioLong: With over a decade of experience in full-stack development, Jane has a deep understanding of building scalable and performant web applications. She is an advocate for open-source and enjoys contributing to the developer community. Her expertise includes Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and various backend technologies. When not coding, Jane enjoys hiking and photography.
